baseHref.description:
Value for base href in index.html. Used if the server is running behind reverse proxy under subpath different from /.
only updates base url of resources on client side,
it's expected that a proxy server rewrites the request URL and gets rid of this prefix
https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/issues/716#issuecomment-433213190

key.description: Key of secret to retrieve the app OIDC client ID

filterGroupsRegex.description:
Filter the groups returned by the OIDC provider
A logical "OR" is used between each regex in the list
- ".*argo-wf.*"
- ".*argo-workflow.*"

insecureSkipVerify.description: Skip TLS verification for the HTTP client

issuer.description: The root URL of the OIDC identity provider

issuerAlias.description: Alternate root URLs that can be included for some OIDC providers

secretWhitelist.description:
Whitelist to allow server to fetch Secrets
When present, restricts secrets the server can read to a given list.
You can use it to restrict the server to only be able to access the
service account token secrets that are associated with service accounts
used for authorization.

redirectUrl.description: The OIDC redirect URL. Should be in the form <argo-root-url>/oauth2/callback.

rootCA.description: Custom PEM encoded CA certificate file contents used to validate the OIDC provider's certificate

scopes.description:
Scopes requested from the SSO ID provider
The 'groups' scope requests group membership information, which is usually used for authorization decisions.
- groups

sessionExpiry.description:
Define how long your login is valid for (in hours)
If omitted, defaults to 10h.

userInfoPath.description:
Specify the user info endpoint that contains the groups claim
Configure this if your OIDC provider provides groups information only using the user-info endpoint (e.g. Okta)

tmpVolume.description: Volume to be mounted in Pods for temporary files.

topologySpreadConstraints.description:
Assign custom [TopologySpreadConstraints] rules to the argo server
Ref: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-topology-spread-constraints/
If labelSelector is left out, it will default to the labelSelector configuration of the deployment
- maxSkew: 1
topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule

volumeMounts.description: Additional volume mounts to the server main container.

volumes.description: Additional volumes to the server pod.

singleNamespace.description:
Restrict Argo to operate only in a single namespace (the namespace of the
Helm release) by apply Roles and RoleBindings instead of the Cluster
equivalents, and start workflow-controller with the --namespaced flag. Use it
in clusters with strict access policy.

useStaticCredentials.description: Use static credentials for S3 (eg. when not using AWS IRSA)
